Integrations.historyUpdating: This call is still updating its record. Wait for it to finish, or stop receiving and wait for cancellation, before querying or removing it.
Integrations.title: Integrations
Integrations.description: Use shared connections as an ordinary App. Home configures accounts and permissions; Lab sends only the request you enter.
Integrations.sessionEnded: This App session ended. Refresh to load the current connections and history. Previous operations won't retry automatically.
Integrations.returnRefresh: Home accepted the navigation. Return here and refresh after granting access.
Integrations.empty: No connections are visible. Connect an account in Home, allow this Lab instance, then refresh.
Integrations.permissionRequired: Home has not allowed this Lab instance to use this connection.
Integrations.waitStopped: Waiting stopped. The saved call remains queryable; a write may already have taken effect.
Integrations.noResend: An unconfirmed write is never resent automatically. Check the original call or handle it manually.
Integrations.bodyPrivacy: History saves call facts and recorded attachment paths by default. Private request and result bodies need the explicit save action below.
Integrations.bodySaved: The currently available private bodies were saved to this call's history.
Integrations.savedSnapshot: App-owned snapshot. This does not query the current Runtime or confirm a new outcome.
Integrations.noSavedBody: No private body was explicitly saved for this record.
Integrations.weixinContextRequired: WeChat needs a received message context for this person. Start receiving, select a message, then reply or send to the same person.
Integrations.selectReceived: Select a received message below to reply.
Integrations.noNativeMessageId: The provider did not supply a platform message ID.
Integrations.receiptBoundary: This confirmation describes the provider response, without confirming recipient delivery.

confirmations.message-created: Provider confirmed message creation or update

Integrations.referenceLocationMissing: The platform did not supply an original message ID; this quote cannot be located here.
Integrations.referenceMediaUnavailable: The original media has no downloadable reference here.

referenceMediaReason.source-not-provided: The platform supplied no download source for this quoted attachment.
referenceMediaReason.source-rejected: This quoted attachment has no accepted download source.

referenceContent.media-provided: Quoted attachments can be saved explicitly; downloading may still fail if the source has expired.
referenceContent.media-metadata-only: Only media metadata was supplied; the original content is unavailable here.
referenceContent.not-provided: The platform did not supply the original content.
referenceContent.unsupported: The supplied quoted content type cannot be displayed here.

errors.INTEGRATION_WEIXIN_RESPONSE_INVALID: WeChat returned a response Nimi could not verify. The operation stopped. Check the network or update Nimi before starting a read again; check the original result before repeating a send.
errors.INTEGRATION_WEIXIN_UPDATES_INVALID: WeChat returned an unreadable message list. Receiving stopped; update Nimi or check the connection before starting again explicitly.
errors.LAB_INTEGRATION_REPLY_TEXT_REQUIRED: Choose a received message with supplied text or platform transcription.
errors.LAB_INTEGRATION_REPLY_DRAFT_INVALID: Inference did not return a complete, nonempty reply within the message limit. No message was requested.
errors.LAB_INTEGRATION_REPLY_SCOPE_ENDED: This App session ended. Receive and select a new message in a freshly admitted session before generating again.
errors.INTEGRATION_CREDENTIAL_EXPIRED: The platform session or token has expired. Refresh this connection in Home, then explicitly restart the task.
errors.INTEGRATION_RATE_LIMITED: The platform rate limit rejected this request. Wait before starting a new task; this call will not be resent.
errors.INTEGRATION_PERMISSION_DENIED: Home has not allowed this operation for this App. Check its connection permissions.
errors.INTEGRATION_WEIXIN_CONTEXT_REQUIRED: Select a received message from the same person to provide a current WeChat reply context.
errors.INTEGRATION_SOURCE_EXPIRED: This source reference has expired. Explicitly receive a new message before replying or fetching its media.
errors.INTEGRATION_CURSOR_EXPIRED: This reader cursor has expired. Start a new receive session; missing events are not replayed.
errors.INTEGRATION_RECEIVER_DRAINING: The previous receiver has not finished stopping. Wait, then explicitly start receiving again.
errors.INTEGRATION_FEISHU_WEBSOCKET_ENDED: The Feishu connection ended. Check the connection and explicitly restart receiving; coverage may be incomplete.
errors.INTEGRATION_FEISHU_PROVIDER_REJECTED: Feishu rejected this request. Check bot permissions, publication status, recipient and message requirements in Feishu.
errors.INTEGRATION_WEIXIN_PROVIDER_REJECTED: WeChat rejected this request. Check the account and the selected person’s current message context.
errors.INTEGRATION_MEDIA_INVALID: The media does not meet the platform’s type, size, image dimensions or filename requirements.
errors.INTEGRATION_MEDIA_INTEGRITY_INVALID: Media bytes do not match the known source size, type or digest. Check the source or select the owned asset again.
errors.INTEGRATION_NETWORK_FAILED: The network request failed. A write may be unconfirmed; check its outcome before creating another send.
errors.INTEGRATION_FEISHU_MESSAGE_TOO_LARGE: The Feishu request is too large after UTF-8 encoding and JSON escaping (text: 150 KiB; card: 30 KiB). Shorten it and send explicitly.

Integrations.importAsset: Import a file into Lab assets
Integrations.mediaInvalid: Choose a nonempty file up to 32 MiB with a valid filename. The platform may impose a smaller limit.
Integrations.previewFailed: This saved media could not be displayed.
Integrations.saveReceivedBatch: Save this received batch’s private bodies
Integrations.invalidFilters: Leave filters empty, or enter 1–64 distinct kind:id conversation filters.
Integrations.invalidFeed: The received Integration feed result is invalid.
Integrations.filtersHelp: Start receiving new messages from this connection. Leave optional filters empty to receive all its new messages; use kind:id, one per line, only for known conversations. Receiving stops after 15 minutes or 100 reads; use Stop at any time. Restart explicitly after an error. Replies require a separate action.
Integrations.downloadPath: New Lab asset path for the selected download
Integrations.noMessages: No received messages in this session.
Integrations.transientMessages: Received bodies are temporary. Save explicitly to history to view them after reopening Lab. Media is saved only when you select Save media.
Integrations.coverageGap: The feed reports a coverage gap: {{gap}}. Missing events are not replayed automatically.
Integrations.receiveEnded: This receive session ended. Start again when needed.
Integrations.saveReceivedBodies: Explicitly save received message bodies to Lab history during this receive session.
Integrations.feishuConversationsHelp: Received Feishu direct and group messages retain chat_id. Choose Conversation to send to a chat, or explicitly enter open_id when sending to a User.
Integrations.qqContextRequired: QQ requires a received-message context for this exact recipient. Start receiving, select a message, then reply or send to the same conversation. C2C context lasts 60 minutes and group context 5 minutes from the original source time; all apps share five replies. Without valid context, active pushing is refused. Inline images/files follow the pinned official SDK; cloud acceptance still depends on the actual account and scene. Inline media is limited to 20 MiB.
Integrations.onebotMediaHelp: OneBot images use owned assets up to 4 MiB. File sending awaits verification of the selected implementation and version. Inbound media needs a usable supported download location; a protocol-end file path is not a Nimi asset.

replyAI.title: AI reply draft
replyAI.description: Select a received message below, then generate a draft with Lab's configured Text Generation capability. Review or edit it before sending once to that original conversation. Nothing replies automatically.
replyAI.textRequired: This message has no supplied text. Choose a message with text or platform transcription; this experiment does not infer content from attachments.
replyAI.saveBodies: Also save the selected message and AI draft bodies in Lab's AI history for this generation. Otherwise only inference facts are saved.
replyAI.configRequired: Review Lab's AI settings before generating: {{detail}}
replyAI.factBoundary: AI facts use the existing AI history; sending has its own Integration call. Stop discards send eligibility and requests cancellation. An already-issued message may still have an effect; its real outcome stays in Integration history. Unknown sends are not retried.

phases.generating: Generating; no message has been requested.
phases.draft: Draft ready for review; sending requires your separate action.
phases.sending: Reply requested once; waiting for the actual outcome.
phases.stopped: Stopped. No draft can be sent from this generation.
phases.sent: The message call completed. This does not prove recipient delivery.
phases.failed: The action did not produce a sendable draft or a confirmed message.

Integrations.historyLoadFailed: Saved history could not be loaded: {{detail}}
Integrations.historyRemoveHelp: Removing a record keeps the files. Manage them in Current Lab files.
Integrations.historicalFilesHelp: Attachment paths saved with this call. Files may have been removed or replaced; use Current Lab files to manage the files that exist now. Removing this record does not remove files.
Integrations.currentFilesHelp: Files owned by this Lab instance, including received media and exports at any managed path. View or open a file location here; deleting a current file does not erase its historical call facts.
Integrations.filesLoadFailed: Lab files could not be loaded. Refresh to try again.
Integrations.fileRemoveFailed: The current file could not be deleted. Check the file and try again.
Integrations.currentFileUnavailable: The current file could not be opened. Refresh the file list and check it again.
Integrations.exportFailed: History export failed. Check Lab file access and try again.
Integrations.exportSavedRevealFailed: History saved to {{path}}, but its location could not be opened. Use the button below to try opening its location again.
